text: Jeans' mom was so helpful and kind with us. I felt home at his apartment. Te neighborhood is awesome, with a lot of students and universities. The facilities were perfect for 3 people and everything was clean and neat. I didn't use metro or bus while there because I rented a car. Anyway, all the touristic areas are so close that it took less than 15 to go to any of them. I could cook at the apartment and wash/dry clothes. This was a hand, because I was traveling for days. I super recommend his apartment. The price is really cheap for what you get :-)

We had a great stay at this apartment. The views of the city and Andes were absolutely incredible. Carlos was very easy to get in touch with and was very helpful. It is very centrally located to museums, great neighborhoods, and restaurants. I would highly recommend this apartment.

A bit tight but my guess is pretty typical. The rooftop access was nice for enjoying the mountains at sunset.
Valentina was a very prompt communicator!

This was not what was expected from a "sparkling clean" stay.
The pros:
- Fantastic view of the city & mountains
- Nice office space
- Proximity to upscale bars and restaurants
The cons:
- Severe lack of cleanliness (i.e. lots of moths in bedroom)
- Door only had keypad lock--no interior locks, deadbolt or otherwise
- Host repeatedly called personal number/ sent Whatsapp messages/ sent AirBnB messages 10+ times over the course of 1 hour (9-10pm) unexpectedly
- Offered parking free of charge at booking and retracted the offer several days into the stay--on short notice

Christobal is very professional.  He was very proactive and responsive.  Even though it was keyless entry, he met me upon departure (at my request).  It’s a great space for one or two people.  It’s centrally located in Providencia on a quiet street and the balcony is great for getting fresh air.
Great Apartment, perfect location close to metro and city. It was very clean and had all the things you could possibly need! Hosts were lovely and gave some great advice. loved our stay here!

Felipe's apartment was great, petit, cozy, with beautiful views and located in a nice, safe area. Felipe was very kind by welcoming us with a complimentary bottle of Chilean wine, and also allowed us to check out later, so we can pack up and relax a bit more before flying back home. Communication was very good as well, fast responding and clear instructions made our experience even more smooth. Apartment is clean and has all the basics that you might need during your stay. Thank you Felipe, and wishing you all the best.

We had a great stay at Cristians place. Cristian is extremely helpful and provided us with all the information that we needed prior to arrival. The space is excellent and had everything we needed. Would definitely stay here again!

A great find! Perfectly located for exploring the city (blocks from a main toll road through Santiago) and for getting up the mountain to ski! Spacious and comfortable - a wonderful spot for a group of friends and/or family coming together. Looking forward to returning in warmer weather to enjoy the outdoor patio space and the pool!
Hosts were communicative, easily available, and incredibly helpful.
excelente apt even has a washing machine. Paola arranged parking really easily. would highly recommend it. clean comfortable and in the summer has AC which is def a bonus
A very nice place for a couple. Gabriel has thought of everything you would need. They view of the Andes is spectacular on a clear day.

An amazing amazing location! Loved staying in Lastarria. The space was cozy and comfortable and I appreciated their was a kitchen as I was traveling for a few days. The building felt safe and secure and is on a well-lit road.

The place was beautiful. Really well maintain. Easy to find and no problems at the moment of checking-in.
Thank you !

Comfortable, well-equipped apartment in a great location. It's just a few minutes from Mercado Tobalaba, the metro, and lots of restaurants. The bed is comfortable and water is strong with high pressure.

The neighborhood is a bit sketchy, so I recommend taking uber. The A/C is very noisy and its exhaust tube doesn't allow the shades to fully cover the window (the flat is on ground floor). The cleaning person forgot a soda in the fridge. Overall an ok stay!

Amazing place to stay in Lastarria. Beautiful space with everything that you need. Secure, walkable and smooth check in. The area is great for food, culture and nature. The host is very helpful and kind. I highly recommend this place. Thank you.

Bernabe was the Best host, just what  you need as first timers to Santiago! To be met at the airport and then sent off (at 5am!!) was just awesome, made our stay so enjoyable and stress free! Everything was perfect as in the listing. We slept well. This was a  great base to explore all the sights, handy for the metro just a few steps away. Shower was a bit small for the husband but the big washing machine made up for it! Bernabe was so generous with breakfast items. We ate out though as there were so many good restaurants and bars around and in neighbouring Lastarria. We felt very safe at Bellas Artes. Thank you for sharing your home with us and making us so welcomed. Muchas gracias!

There were several things that made this stay stand out. I liked the skylight in the room. The wifi is fast, especially the upload speed if you need to do video calls. The TV is a good size. There are plenty of power outlets where you need them.  The rental is on the ground level so there are no stairs to walk up. It's easy to get in and out of the room and it felt safe. There is a deadbolt in addition to the door lock. The kitchen has an oven, microwave, and gas stove burners. The hosts are really nice and take good care of the rental. Overall, my stay was a good value.
We're grateful to have stayed at David's apartment! It's a little cozy for a family of 4, but we spent a lot of time going out, so it was fine. Highly recommended
Great place, it has everything you need. Unfortunately no wifi when we were there which was really disappointing as we work remotely, had to check out early.

Great place in an excellent safe quiet neighbourhood / quiet and cool with fans - big and spacious / good TV a very short walk to tons and tons of of restaurants and bars all pretty good in Barrio Italia - 3 mins walk from the flat - the door entry system with 4 x different lock codes and 2 x keys to get in is over complicated
And could / should be simplified with keys as nobody can remember 4 x codes late at night - the addition of some coffee or tea and some bottled water for the first night would be hospitable the flat is really spacious however - I would stay again due to the close proximity to a great area as above and it was good to be able to stow our bags for a few hours prior to check in at a rather late 5 pm - which I had not fully appreciated. Thanks

I absolutely loved my stay at this wonderful unit.
Location is prime and it’s close to everything you need while still being quiet and peaceful.
The staff are very friendly.
The apartment itself is cozy, clean and has everything the listing mentions!
Lastly, some of the very best hosts one can ask for as they are friendly, helpful, attentive, kind and very accommodative!
Thank you! Will definitely return

Excellent budget option in Santiago - the place is clean and within close distance to many of the city’s attractions. It’s not located in the safest neighbourhood but I wouldn’t call it sketchy either.
Very nice stay. the view is  incredible and the hosts were very proactive and helpful. Will stay here again for sure next time.

Good location in Providencia - felt very safe, and walkable to other areas including the San Cristobal hill. Ubers were also very cheap to get around the city.
There are a couple of "corner shops" next door and a Starbucks round the corner. There is a Santa Isabel supermarket about 10 minutes walk and a huge shopping centre about 20 minutes walk.
The flat was clean and had all the essentials. Clara was very responsive
The apartment gym was quite spacious but only had a couple of old weight machines. We didn't try the pool.

Clean, great value, close to metro, overall pleasant, comfortable space, perfect for exploring Santiago or catching Skitotal bus to Valle Nevado. The building was also very nice with concierge, and plenty of conveniences right in the neighborhood as well and restaurants within a stone's throw. Thanks Andrea!

This condominium has a magnificent view of the mountains from a wrap-around balcony, is comfortable and looks exactly as pictured, and has a well-stocked kitchen. There were just two of us, and we had access to 3 bedrooms and only 1 of 2 bathrooms - do bring your own soap, shampoo, conditioner. Sound carries in the hallways, so it makes sense that the TV volume is locked at a moderate level. The thermostat is also locked at a comfortable level - we likely could have negotiated with Francisco if we needed a cooler sleeping temperature. The storage room for skis and boots is easy to access and locks are provided. You can ski out in good snow conditions. Francisco was super responsive. The staff members in the lobby, particularly Flavio, were also extremely welcoming. We enjoyed our stay!

I confirm that this apartment is in exact best location in Lastarria.  Right in center but private and secure with 24/7 concierge.  It is very nice to have two bathrooms with bathtubs.   The apartment is significantly less expensive than the other apartments and hotels.  It provides value.  Last, the hosts are very responsive and KIND.
